question: Under which of the following Schedules of the Indian Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 are the Gangetic Dolphins protected?
solution:
The correct answer is __**First Schedule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gangetic Dolphins** are the **National Aquatic Animal of India**.

 
 
• They are found in the rivers of **Ganga, Brahmaputra and Meghna**.
 
• They live only in freshwater and are found in **Nepal, India, and Bangladesh**.
 
• They are **essentially blind mammals**.
 
• Due to the construction of dams, increasing pollution and catch in fishnets leads to habitat loss.
 
• For their conservation government has taken various measures like
 
 
• **Project Dolphin**
 
• **Establishment of Vikramshila Ganges Dolphin Sanctuary in Bihar.**
 
• **Protected under Indian Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972​**
